capabilities: Ask natural-language questions and get answers cited to specific vault notes
Index the vault on first run for retrieval-augmented context search
Chat with local LLM backends such as LM Studio and llama.cpp
Focus the conversation on the currently open note
Tune models, search parameters, and token limits
extras: Early Access (RAG Beta); listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Agent-like editing and automation features are planned but not yet available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask natural-language questions across notes and get answers grounded in vault content.

relations.evidence: This plugin integrates with local LLM services but does not include any of their code

requires.name: LM Studio (or llama.cpp) local endpoint, or an external provider API such as OpenAI or Anthropic

summary: Chat with your vault: ask natural-language questions and get answers grounded in your notes via local RAG with LM Studio, llama.cpp, or external LLM APIs.
